notes.title: Anniversary Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey farmers!
It’s time to celebrate the [b]first anniversary of Sunrise's Order[/b]. 🥳

Over the past year, we’ve seen Sunrise's Order grow with new content and countless improvements that have made it even better than it was at launch.
This project actually started from a completely silly idea: [i]ordering a cow on Animazon and having it parachuted from a plane[/i].

We guess that explains why our game is sprinkled with a touch of humor from start to finish! 😆

If you enjoy the updates to Sunrise's Order, let us know by [b]leaving a review on Steam[/b]! ✍️ Your support [b]motivates us and encourages us to keep expanding the game[/b]. 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133049/d80559f8946e3feef620d880d0255743b239db78.png[/img]
Now, here are a few details about the new features:

🪴 Every time you level up a profession to level 5, 8, or 12, a [b]new decorative plant or flower[/b] will become available for purchase on Animazon.

🏠 The same goes for [b]wall and floor[/b] coverings. To install one, make sure you're inside your house, select the item from your inventory bar, and place it using the "Use" button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133049/f3b67c5ab799abd2041e9a10886fa3ffc9f5f3bd.png[/img]
Here are the other changes included in the update below.

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New wall and floor decoration system
[*] Set of decorative plants and flowers
[*] New set of walls
[*] New set of floors
[*] New cutscene to help players complete their first contract
[*] Using the action button on the Shipping Box now deposits an entire stack instead of one item at a time
[*] Using the action button on a factory now retrieves the first ready stack
[*] Added a collision when repairing the internet at the beginning of the game
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Chests now appear at the top of the furniture list on Animazon
[*] Furniture order on Animazon has been reorganized
[*] Standardization of some UI elements
[*] Updated studio logo
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where upgrading a building could corrupt the save file
[*] Fixed a bug where a factory remained active after loading a saved game
[/list]
If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

Don't hesitate to follow us on our different social media:
[b][url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url] - [url=https://twitter.com/MissticStudio]Twitter[/url] - [url=https://www.facebook.com/MissticStudio]Facebook[/url] - [url=https://bsky.app/profile/missticstudio.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url][/b]

notes.title: Update Notes 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello, farmers!
Today's the big day: our [b]new update[/b] has arrived. It’s time to warm your heart with a nice hot chocolate in Sunrise's Order. ☕❄️

If you enjoy the updates for Sunrise's Order, it’s important to let us know by [b]supporting us with your reviews on Steam[/b]. ✍️ Knowing that you appreciate what we’re doing always brings us great joy. 💖

Regarding the new features, here are a few additional details:
🐮 The [b]two new animals[/b] are available from the [b]beginning of Year 2[/b] on Animazon.

👗 For [b]skins[/b], you can choose them from the [b]beginning of the game[/b] during character creation or [b]unlock them with the mirror[/b] during your playthrough.

🎅 [b]Christmas decorations[/b] are available starting the [b]first winter[/b] of the first year. Here they are in images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133049/bf9521f687bb5e12e272af1e3e14e8b70d3f1651.png[/img]
Finally, we’d like to take a moment to wish you happy holidays and a wonderful 2025. We sincerely hope you'll stay with us for the rest of our journey. ⛄

Discover the other new features and changes brought by the update just below.

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of 2 new animals: Chocolate Cow and Strawberry Cow.
[*] Addition of 5 new clothing colorations.
[*] New holiday-themed decoration furniture.
[*] The calendar now displays the birth date of newborns.
[*] New objectives have been added at the beginning of the game.
[*] New contracts have been added at the beginning of the game to help you start your adventure.
[*] Addition of the ingredient Strawberry Milk.
[*] Addition of the Hot Chocolate recipe.
[*] Addition of the Chocolate Mousse recipe.
[*] Addition of the Chocolate Pudding recipe.
[*] Addition of the Milkshake recipe.
[*] Addition of the Strawberry Juice recipe.
[*] Addition of the Strawberry Ice Cream recipe.
[*] Added an option to skip the opening introduction.
[*] Added the onigiri to the museum.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The mine now saves up to level 100.
[*] Rebalancing of ores to better distribute them across the 20 new levels of the mine.
[*] Buildings now have a maximum number of animals they can accommodate.
[*] When the medicine is selected, the ground cursor turns green if the targeted animal is sick.
[*] Improvement of the pond mechanics.
[*] Modification of the pond menu to make it easier to use.
[*] Enhancement of the pond tutorial for better clarity.
[*] The chances of catching fish in the pond are now updated instantly.
[*] After each night, the percentage of fish discovered in the pond increases for a maximum of 3 nights.
[*] The fishing rod is available at the start of the game in the toolbox.
[*] Improvement of the effect of Animazon packages when they are hidden behind an object.
[*] Players using keyboard/mouse can now remove the "!" in the Animazon menu by hovering over the items with the mouse instead of clicking.
[*] You can now get rid of a duplicate plan or recipe directly from the inventory.
[*] Adjustment of the size of some furniture to better fit the character's size.
[*] Change of the default key to add a fish to the pond, changing from "Use" to "Action1."
[*] Reduction of the resources required to craft the campfire.
[*] Reordered tools in the workshop.
[*] The quick-sell action now deposits the entire stack of items.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the tutorial menu from closing properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed subscriptions to give the same unique item multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug where animals did not always eat food from the feeders.
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]
If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update Notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello farmers!
Version 1.1.0 of [b]Sunrise's Order[/b] is just around the corner. We have some exciting new features that should enhance your enjoyment. Let me tell you about the most important updates in detail:

🧭🗺️ A [b]treasure hunt[/b] has begun! Keep an eye out while exploring your island, as you might stumble upon a [b]small clue[/b] and find a treasure!

In July, we conducted a survey to find out what decorations you'd like for your home. The votes were close between potted plants 🪴 and plushies, with the latter winning. We've added [b]10 new plushies[/b] to find during your treasure hunt. 🧸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133049/427052fa6e4bd47240a212736254617a499a92be.png[/img]

Here's a new feature that will improve your farming life. From now on, bronze, silver, and gold [b]hoes will dig multiple tiles[/b] at once. This will greatly speed up your mining excursions. 🪨

Another point that will please many is that with the new update, [b]you no longer need to have your materials in your inventory to craft[/b] items with the factories. You can leave everything in your various chests. The factories will take into account what’s in your chests. 🧰

We also wanted to mention that we now have a [url=https://sunrisesorder.fandom.com/wiki/Sunrise%27s_Order_Wiki][b]Wiki[/b][/url] for Sunrise's Order. 🖥️ For now, it only has basic information, but it will be updated over time.

Check out the other new features and changes brought by the update just below.

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 10 new plushies to decorate your home.
[*] Strange clues sometimes appear on the island's ground.
[*] Higher-level hoes now dig a larger area.
[*] Factories now use materials from the chests.
[*] The character now appears on the map to help with orientation.
[*] Repairs now use materials from the chests.
[*] Furniture can now be stored in the Wooden Tall Cabinet and the Enchanted Wardrobe (100 slots).
[*] When searching for new contracts, you can see the quantity you have in your inventory.
[*] Plans have a new appearance to differentiate them from recipes.
[*] Added a basic scythe on Animazon to make the scythe more accessible early in the game.
[*] Added the Omelette recipe.
[*] Added the Butter Chicken recipe.
[*] Animazon offers a wider range of ingredients and materials.
[*] Added new character customization options available at the start of a new game.
[*] Added new dialogues.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Silos now feed a maximum number of animals.
[*] Hoes have been rebalanced to account for recent changes.
[*] Items are now listed by type on Animazon.
[*] Tools no longer lose durability if the targeted object cannot be destroyed.
[*] Improved movement speed in the construction app.
[*] Changed the recipes for "Omelette" and "Double Omelette"; their names are now "Cooked Egg" and "2 Cooked Eggs."
[*] Balanced the values of some items.
[*] Balanced the recipes for workshops and factories.
[*] Balanced fertilizers to make them more accessible.
[*] Balanced the scents on garbage.
[*] Balanced the value of several cooking recipes.
[*] Balanced the energy provided by certain meals.
[*] Modified the description of broccoli seeds.
[*] Trash bags no longer spread.
[*] Adding fuel now uses materials from the chests.
[*] Trash bags no longer spread.
[*] It is now possible to add fuel using materials directly from the chests.
[*] The character refuses to fish if they don’t have enough energy.
[*] Changed the selection colors for breakable and unbreakable objects.
[*] Clarified the conditions for unlocking each building.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where items in material chests were not always counted when finishing contracts or in the construction menu on the computer.
[*] Fixed a bug where animals did not eat outside according to the temperature.
[*] Fixed a bug where feeders could feed the same animal multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed unlocking skills in skill trees without the necessary prerequisites.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented closing the tutorial during the first interaction with the pond.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not always update unpinned objectives.
[*] Fixed a bug related to animals.
[*] Fixed the durability function for animal tools.
[*] Fixed a bug where watering cans would empty when stored.
[/list]
If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi!
Recently, we received [b]several suggestions[/b] from [b]community members[/b] to improve the player experience, and we thought it would be good to integrate these recommendations into Sunrise's Order.

Thank you all for taking the time to write to us so that we can continue to improve the game and make it even more enjoyable to play!

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to see the durability of a tool in your inventory.
[*] The mine level is now always displayed.
[*] Basic tools are now available on Animazon.
[*] Branches and little stones are available on Animazon.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified the text of a cutscene to indicate that you need to buy the Transformer rather than craft it.
[*] Improved the condition for the Transformer to be available on Animazon.
[*] Animal health now restores gradually each day but decreases more quickly if the animal is not well treated.
[*] Increased the spawn rate of wood and stones.
[*] The arrival time of a package now depends on the time of order.
[*] The mine level selection is now set by default to the deepest point reached and saved by the player.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that did not correctly display the 4th ingredient in crafting recipes.
[*] Fixed descriptions of basic tools that incorrectly indicated they were still unbreakable.
[*] Fixed an erroneous mine floor save notification.
[/list]
If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.6.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋
Today, we gather for an update that brings a [b]plethora of changes[/b] to Sunrise's Order. We've also addressed [b]numerous minor issues[/b] along the way.

We hope these modifications will meet your expectations and make your experience on [b]Sunrise's Orde[/b]r even more enjoyable and pleasant! 💪

We invite you to explore everything with the list below:

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Displaying the shortcut "Action1" when available.
[*] New setting available: VSync!
[*] Adding a title during conversations when it's not the farmer speaking.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Stone tools are no longer unique. They can now be sold, broken, and crafted multiple times.
[*] Rebalancing the likelihood of dead plants providing seeds.
[*] In the development tree, the position of the factory plot and the furnace has been swapped.
[*] Visual enhancement in the development tree.
[*] Reordering of crafting lists.
[*] Balancing values and crafting materials for gold jewelry.
[*] Increased respawn rate of herbs and stones.
[*] Increased appearance rate of shells at the beginning of the game.
[*] Improved construction menu when modifying a building.
[*] Enhanced virtual keyboard in the "Enter Code" menu. Unavailable keys are displayed better.
[*] Buttons on animal feeders have been reversed:
    The "Use" button fills the feeder completely.
    The "Action1" button provides a single ration.
[*] Tools are better positioned in the character's hand.
[*] The basic watering can is now named "Water Bucket".
[*] Grass collision has been improved.
[*] Enlargement of small texts to fit the Steamdeck.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The virtual keyboard is operational again.
[*] Fixed a bug where the virtual keyboard would appear off-screen.
[*] High-level watering cans now properly target tiles in the greenhouse.
[*] Fixed a tile that wasn't accepting bushes when it should have.
[*] In the computer subscription menu, the back button now returns us to the correct menu.
[*] Fixed a display issue with the Enchanted China Cabinet.
[*] It is no longer possible to open a menu while the character is fainting.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed duplicating an item, encouraging the player to do so.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that briefly displayed the same contract twice. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello farmers!
Happy New Year to everyone; we hope you had an enjoyable holiday season. On our end, the end of the year has been more than busy with the launch of Sunrise's Order and our other commitments, so we took the opportunity to recharge our batteries.

We're back in full swing, and we wanted to kick off this year with an update that some have been eagerly anticipating. We've overhauled the [b]inventory interfaces[/b]. The most significant changes are in the menus of [b]the sales box and the storage chest.[/b]

Now, the left page will display the items in your backpack, and the right page will show the items stored in the chest. Previously, both sets of information shared the left page, and the right page was used to display product information.

With these new changes, it will be easier for you to navigate your chests and inventory as more items will be displayed simultaneously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42133049/1cde7462969d12227d435f22f1dc310b0bf0b62b.png[/img]

Another exciting feature is that [b]the farm level[/b] now affects the [b]quality of your items and harvests[/b]. So, it will be easier for you to obtain items of bronze, silver, gold, and platinum levels.

One last useful addition concerns [b]the watering cans[/b]. From now on, your [b]higher-quality watering cans will water multiple plots of land simultaneously[/b]. This change will save you time in your day as a little farmer.

Here's the list of other changes we've made to Sunrise's Order:

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The farm level now affects the quality of items and harvests.
[*] Higher-quality watering cans (bronze, silver, and gold) water more areas at once.
[*] A button to show and hide information for selected items in the chest menus.
[*] Text will now display the type of animal we are about to name on the virtual keyboard.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved user interface for inventory menus, especially those of the chest and sales box.
[*] Changed the way information for selected items is displayed in the inventory.
[*] Items on the ground take longer before turning into waste.
[*] Waste on the ground generates fewer new wastes rapidly.
[*] If a player reaches outside the walls, they will be teleported back home.
[*] Rebalancing of watering cans.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where one could wake up outside the house.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the selection of loop skins at the start of a new game.
[*] We corrected the text of skill points in the end-of-day summary screen as it was not displaying completely.
[*] Offered energy is now displayed appropriately according to the object's level.
[*] Resolved an animation bug with the development bar during the initial loading.
[*] Resolved an animation bug with the development bar if multiple levels were accumulated simultaneously.
[/list]
If you encounter any problems, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y5XjTaWgH9]Discord[/url].

For just over a month now, Sunrise's Order has been available in early access. We want to express our deep gratitude for your support.
Today we are releasing a [b]major update[/b] primarily focused on the [b]skill trees[/b].

After an in-depth analysis, we decided to [b]rebalance[/b] the skill trees so that each invested point has a significant impact on your progression. Previously, the entire skill tree required an investment of 210 points. With this update, only [b]88 points[/b] are needed, distributed across 5 trees instead of 6.

Some talents, less relevant for the game's progression, have been removed, but rest assured, [b]new skills[/b] that we believe you'll enjoy have replaced them.

We look forward to seeing how you will take advantage of these new changes. Thank you again for playing Sunrise's Order.

notes.title: Update Notes 0.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Sunrise's Order has been in early access for a week now.
We hope you're enjoying your gaming experience so far!
A big thank you to each and every one of you for joining us on this adventure. Your support is invaluable.

We plan to update every 1-2 weeks, preferably late Thursday afternoons, based on player suggestions, improvements and other feedback.
This week, we've been working on a good update that brings changes to make your gaming experience easier.

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now, it will be possible to consult the names of items requested in contracts.
[*] Add a subscription that lets you see the location of packages on the map.
[*] Add a subscription to deliver packages directly to your front door.
[*] When the dog eats a bone, it sniffs a package and indicates it to the player.
[*] Achievements appear as in-game notifications when unlocked.
[*] A new dialog is added when the first fish is caught.
[*] Mouse clicks activate actions in the mouse direction.
[/list]
[h3][b]Modifications and improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 3 parcels require less energy.
[*] The free delivery option is now always available.
[*] The price of standard delivery has been lowered.
[*] Animazon Express subscription price increase.
[*] No delivery charge when choosing Animazon Express as delivery method.
